offline_download_transfer: Transfer downloaded file to corresponding storage
copy: Copy file from a storage to another storage
move: Move file from a storage to another storage
decompress: Download and decompress an archive file
decompress_upload: Upload extracted files into target storage

submission_state.legacy: Historical task without a reliable receipt

cloud_reason.unsupported_tool: This task type or download tool does not support 115 cloud record cleanup.
cloud_reason.capability_unavailable: The server did not confirm cloud cleanup support for this task.
cloud_reason.source_file_capability_unavailable: The server did not confirm source file deletion support, or the previous cleanup request kept files.
cloud_reason.source_file_delete_unconfirmed: The cloud record is absent, but source file deletion is unconfirmed. The task was kept for checking.
cloud_reason.delete_option_conflict: Keep the source file option from the previous cleanup request. An unconfirmed request cannot change that choice.
cloud_reason.task_retried: The task has been retried. Refresh the list before continuing.
cloud_reason.task_removed: The local task has already been removed.
cloud_reason.task_not_finished: The local task must finish before its cloud record can be deleted.
cloud_reason.legacy_task: This historical task has no reliable cloud receipt.
cloud_reason.cloud_reference_missing: The task is missing a reliable receipt or its original storage and account binding.
cloud_reason.cleanup_state_invalid: The saved cleanup state is not supported.
cloud_reason.storage_missing: The original storage no longer exists.
cloud_reason.storage_changed: The original storage driver has changed.
cloud_reason.account_changed: The original 115 account has changed or is unavailable.
cloud_reason.cloud_record_reappeared: A cloud record with this hash appeared after cleanup. It was kept to avoid deleting a new download.
cloud_reason.cloud_task_active: The 115 download is still active. Its cloud record was kept.
cloud_reason.cloud_state_unknown: The current 115 download state could not be confirmed.
cloud_reason.persistence_failed: The cleanup result could not be saved locally. The task was kept.
cloud_reason.operation_canceled: The cleanup operation was interrupted. Check its state before trying again.
cloud_reason.cloud_query_failed: The 115 cloud record could not be checked. The task was kept.
cloud_reason.cloud_delete_unknown: 115 did not confirm the deletion result. The task was kept for a later check.
cloud_reason.task_not_found: The task no longer exists or is not accessible.
cloud_reason.response_unconfirmed: The server did not confirm cleanup for this task. Refresh and check before trying again.
cloud_reason.request_failed: The server could not complete this operation. Check the details below.
cloud_reason.network_unknown: No response was received. The operation may have reached the server; refresh and check before trying again.
cloud_reason.other: Cloud cleanup is unavailable. Refresh the list and check the task details.

delete_dialog.clear_succeeded: Clear all successful tasks of this type? {{count}} tasks are currently in scope.
delete_dialog.clear_scope: Clear covers this entire task type, including other pages and tasks hidden by filters. It also includes matching tasks that finish before the server processes the request.
delete_dialog.delete_files_notice: This also deletes the 115 cloud files or folders belonging to these download tasks.
delete_dialog.keep_files: Only download records are deleted. Downloaded files are kept.
delete_dialog.recheck: The server checks each task again when processing the request. Unsupported tasks and tasks that fail cloud cleanup stay in the list.
delete_dialog.available: Cloud cleanup is available; the current 115 download state will be checked before deletion.
delete_dialog.summary: {{removed}} tasks confirmed removed; {{retained}} tasks not confirmed removed.
delete_dialog.removed: Removed from the OpenList task list.
delete_dialog.retained: The task was not confirmed removed. Check its details before trying again.
delete_dialog.confirm_cloud_files: Delete tasks, cloud records and source files
delete_dialog.network_unknown: No response was received. The operation may have reached the server. Refresh and check the task states before trying again.
delete_dialog.refresh_failed: The task list could not be refreshed. Any confirmed deletion results remain valid; refresh the list again later.
delete_dialog.no_targets: There are no matching tasks to delete.
